thesis_statement: Ecolab is a pricing-power compounder: water, hygiene and infection-prevention franchises with an energy-surcharge mechanism that passed rising commodity costs through in one quarter, plus two AI-adjacent growth engines (Global High-Tech +29%, and the CoolIT liquid-cooling acquisition extending Ecolab into data-center thermal management).

base.summary: Mid-single-digit organic sales growth with 5-6% second-half pricing holds organic margins roughly stable and delivers the raised 7-10% adjusted EPS growth.
drivers: energy surcharge implemented globally in one quarter
One Ecolab share gains in Food & Beverage, Institutional, Light Water
Global High-Tech (+29%) and Life Sciences (+15%) engines

bull.summary: AI data-center cooling demand makes CoolIT a material third engine on top of the core franchise, and H2 pricing at the top of the 5-6% range expands organic gross margin.
drivers: CoolIT extending into AI infrastructure liquid cooling
Ovivo Electronics performing above plan (mid-teens growth vs pre-acquisition)
volume growth strengthening as Middle East disruption fades

bear.summary: Commodity costs keep rising faster than the surcharge can recover, Middle East disruption persists, and premium-multiple de-rating compounds an organic-growth stall.
drivers: ~38x trailing earnings for a mid-single-digit organic grower
acquisition amortization drag (Ovivo, CoolIT) on reported margins

key_risks: Valuation: ~37.6x trailing and ~29.7x forward for mid-single-digit organic growth leaves little room for execution error.

Adjusted gross margin declined 60 bps on the Ovivo Electronics acquisition impact; organic gross margin only stabilized after a transition quarter - the commodity pass-through is not yet proven over a full cycle.
Middle East conflict is a live, named headwind (~1% volume disruption in the quarter).
CoolIT/Ovivo integration and amortization costs are the stated drag on 3Q guidance (+3% to +8% EPS growth only).

catalysts.event: Second-half pricing at the 5-6% company target

evidence.claim: Q2 2026: reported sales $4.4B +10%, organic +5%; reported diluted EPS $1.90 +3%, adjusted $2.09 +11%; organic operating margin 18.8% +40bps; organic gross margin stabilized after Ovivo impact; pricing 4% improving to 5-6% expected in H2 via energy surcharge; Global High-Tech +29%, Life Sciences +15%; ~1% volume headwind from Middle East-disrupted customers; raised 2026 adjusted EPS outlook to $8.05-$8.25 (+7-10%); CoolIT closed, extending water tech into AI infrastructure
